paired_design.pair_ordinal_rule: sort all 32 selected assignments by candidate_index ascending and use the zero-based position
paired_design.within_stratum_rank_rule: within each construction stratum sort its eight candidate indices ascending and use the zero-based position
paired_design.condition_order_rule: even within-stratum rank has factual in phase 1 and sham in phase 2; odd rank has sham in phase 1 and factual in phase 2
paired_design.public_task_sequence: phase 1 in pair-ordinal order followed by phase 2 in pair-ordinal order; each phase has four factual and four sham tasks per construction stratum

matched_sham.candidate_pool: all frozen motif-library members with the factual motif's stratum and complexity bucket, excluding every motif with the factual motif's complete-domain behavior
matched_sham.semantic_alias_handling: group candidates by complete-domain motif behavior, choose one target-blind hash representative per behavior, then rank behavior groups so syntax-rich aliases receive no extra weight
matched_sham.public_support_mask: ten K1/control-ready bits computed only from target-independent D0, parent, domain and evidence-point locations
matched_sham.target_free_world_reconstruction: call the existing cached _world_structure(world_seed), label D0 with hypotheses[0] from the shared training-signature bank, use inert zero labels for evidence/test because K1 reads only their point locations, set no derived target, and verify D0/parent against the sealed public identity
matched_sham.primary_rank: minimum Hamming distance from the factual motif's ten-bit public support mask
matched_sham.public_pair_anchor: SHA-256 of canonical JSON {upstream_public_identity_sha256, witness_slot_id}; these fields are target-free construction identities and never enter the provider-facing manifest
matched_sham.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma and colon, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false
matched_sham.alias_representative_rule: within each behavior group choose ascending SHA-256 of canonical JSON {namespace, phase='alias-representative', pair_anchor_sha256, motif_behavior_hash, motif_canonical_hash}; motif_id is the final deterministic tie-break
matched_sham.behavior_tie_break_rule: after computing the representative's support-mask distance, choose ascending tuple (Hamming distance, SHA-256 of canonical JSON {namespace, phase='behavior-tie', pair_anchor_sha256, motif_behavior_hash, representative_canonical_hash}, motif_behavior_hash, representative motif_id)

expected_pre_model_audit.interpretation: the three K1-invalid frames are misses, not valid matched replacements that failed closure

forbidden_selection_inputs: whether the sham has zero K4 opportunities

choice_masking.base_permutation_rule: sort raw action indices by SHA-256(protocol_id + ':base-option-permutation:' + decimal raw index)
choice_masking.pair_permutation_rule: left-cyclically rotate the frozen base permutation by pair ordinal modulo 10
choice_masking.global_position_balance: each semantic action occurs in each display position three or four times across 32 pairs
choice_masking.opaque_id_rule: for each pair and display position use Q plus the first eight uppercase hex characters of SHA-256 canonical JSON {namespace, pair_anchor_sha256, display_position}; reject any within-pair collision
choice_masking.opaque_task_id_rule: SHA-256 of ASCII opaque_task_namespace + ':' + lowercase kind ('task' or 'pair') + ':' followed by canonical JSON {pair_anchor_sha256, arm}; base32 without padding, first 14 characters, output prefix TASK- or PAIR-; pair payload is {pair_anchor_sha256}

recursively_forbidden: factual, sham, true, control or witness labels
target identity or labels outside D0
endpoint flags, trajectories, N_T or control outcomes
provider_facing_public_manifest.cross_binding: public manifest carries a recomputable private-design commitment; private key carries the public-manifest digest; the later sealed plan binds both file digests and their exact 64-task bijection

response_contract.value: exactly one opaque option ID listed in that prompt
response_contract.valid_provider_response_with_invalid_cho: retain fixed denominator as K1=K2=K3=K4_full_pool=0; no retry
response_contract.transport_or_missing_response: joint attempt is non-evaluable; no replacement call

target_blind_structural_baselines.heuristic_domain: select only K1-supported actions; first-public-K1 uses the earliest supported display position; if none exist choose display position 0
target_blind_structural_baselines.heuristic_final_tie_break: after each named primary score, use node count where not already primary, child canonical hash, then raw action index
target_blind_structural_baselines.strongest_deterministic_baseline: before any model call, select the deterministic non-uniform policy with the most factual-arm K4_full_pool hits; break ties by ascending frozen policy ID
target_blind_structural_baselines.information_boundary: K1 heuristics may use target-free evidence-point locations not shown in the provider prompt, so they are deliberately information-advantaged structural baselines, not strictly prompt-visible policies
target_blind_structural_baselines.interpretation: B* is an outcome-aware but pre-model adversarial shortcut hurdle; it cannot count as model evidence

analysis.paired_test: one-sided exact McNemar/sign test on factual-versus-sham K2 discordances
analysis.shortcut_test: one-sided exact McNemar/sign test on factual K4_full_pool model hits versus the frozen strongest deterministic baseline
analysis.uniform_test: exact Poisson-binomial upper tail with per-world probability equal to factual K4 action count divided by ten
analysis.exact_mcnemar_formula: for b favorable and c unfavorable discordances, sum choose(b+c,k)/2^(b+c) for k=b..b+c; zero discordances gives p=1; no mid-p or two-sided substitution
analysis.uniform_gate: observed factual K4 count has exact Poisson-binomial upper-tail p at most alpha, equivalently reaches or exceeds the minimum attainable critical count
analysis.route_multiplicity: for three frozen routes define p_route=max(paired_p, shortcut_p), then apply Holm family-wise correction at alpha=0.05

route_gates.paired_direction: factual-only K2 discordances exceed sham-only discordances
route_gates.shortcut_direction: model-only K4 discordances exceed baseline-only discordances
route_gates.p_route: maximum of paired raw p and shortcut raw p
route_gates.nonconstant_child_definition: the selected child complete-domain behavior contains both 0 and 1

new_format_canary.purpose: JSON-object and opaque-choice parsing plus exact route contract only

later_sealed_plan_barrier.provider_message_may_contain: rendered_prompt bytes only; do not send task_id or provider metadata derived from pair/arm
later_sealed_plan_barrier.private_key_load_time: only after all three complete 64-response generation artifacts are sealed

interpretation_limits: The 32 worlds are an outcome-conditioned finite-DSL challenge set, not a natural-world sample.
A positive route supports a prompt-level matched-context mechanism in this benchmark, not human-unknown discovery or a universal entropy law.
K4_full_pool is complete only over the frozen same-frame motif replacement library.
A failed route does not prove that useful spark-guided discovery is impossible in other tasks, prompts or models.
